name: Agentic Systems Lab - Bounded Async Polling

parameters.jsCode: const s=String($json.provider_status||'').trim().toLowerCase(); const ok=['completed','succeeded','done','success']; const fail=['failed','cancelled','canceled','error']; let decision; if(ok.includes(s)) decision={action:'COMPLETE',reason:'TERMINAL_SUCCESS'}; else if(fail.includes(s)) decision={action:'STOP',reason:'TERMINAL_FAILURE'}; else if(Number($json.attempt)>=Number($json.max_attempts)) decision={action:'STOP',reason:'MAX_ATTEMPTS'}; else if(Number($json.elapsed_ms)>=Number($json.max_elapsed_ms)) decision={action:'STOP',reason:'DEADLINE_EXCEEDED'}; else decision={action:'WAIT_AND_POLL',reason:'NON_TERMINAL',delay_ms:Math.min(30000,1000*(2**Math.min(Number($json.attempt||0),5)))}; return [{json:{...$json,decision}}];
